title: Chevrolet Suburban Engines by Year (1960–2026)
description: Every factory engine in the Chevrolet Suburban by year, 1960–2026: sixes, small and big block V8s, the 6.2 and 6.5 diesels, Vortec V8s and the Duramax.
intro: The Suburban is the longest-running nameplate in American motoring. Through 1991 this page lists the half-ton Suburban; from 1992 it lists the 1500 and 2500, with 2500-only engines marked. Heavier half-ton Suburbans from about 1975 carried heavy-duty emissions ratings that differ from the pickups.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.
The 235, 230 and 250 sixes, the 292 six from 1963, and the 283 and 327 V8s.
The sixes and the 283, 307, 327, 350, 396 and 402 V8s.
The 250 six, the 305, 350, 400 and 454 V8s, and the 6.2 diesel from 1982.

generations.name: K2XX
intro: The 5.3 EcoTec3 V8 and the 6.2 from 2018.

generations.name: T1
intro: The 5.3 and 6.2 V8s and the 3.0 Duramax diesel.

method: Every engine and year listed here was confirmed by at least three independent sources: the NHRA Stock Car Classification Guides, factory material such as GM Heritage Center information kits and sales brochures, EPA records and established references. Several Wikipedia articles count as one source. Where sources give different ratings, the factory figure is shown and the difference is noted. Factory race-only packages need two sources.
